نتصادق (form VI)
# نَتَصَادَقُ (nataṣādaqu) /na.ta.sˤaː.da.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَادَقَ (taṣādaqa)
# نَتَصَادَقَ (nataṣādaqa) /na.ta.sˤaː.da.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَادَقَ (taṣādaqa)
# نَتَصَادَقْ (nataṣādaq) /na.ta.sˤaː.daq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَادَقَ (taṣādaqa)
